ἰσότης, -ητος, ἡ
(ἴσος), [in LXX: Job.36:30, Zec.4:7 * ;]

elsewhere.note: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack; that there may be…
Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.
